It has meaning not only in wartime and also in times of peace, the period of economic growth.

Quốc lộ 1A đi qua 31 tỉnh, trong đó có 4.en: The 1A Highway passes through 31 provinces, including 4 major cities: Hanoi, Dawan, Ho Chi Minh City and Needs Poem The North South Highway connects the two North Vietnamese of Vietnam which are located very close to Route 1A. In contrast with Highway 1A leading from the Mountain to the Mau, the North South Highway connects only from Hanoi to the Ninch with a total length of 170,000 km.
Quốc lộ 1A đi qua 31 tỉnh, trong đó có 4.zh: 1A高速公路经过31个省,包括4个大城市:河内,达万,胡志明市和需要Poem. 南北高速公路连接了越南两个北越,它们都非常靠近1A公路. 与1A号高速公路从 Mountain山至茂名段形成对比,南北高速公路仅连接河内至宁夏段,全长17万公里.

Quốc lộ 1A được hình thành khi đất nước.en: Highway 1A was formed when our country was divided into two domestic and foreign regions. Highway 1A has helped to develop the economy which it passes through throughout its history. When society makes changes, the 1A Highway also follows that there are certain changes to adjust the flow of goods and transport.
Quốc lộ 1A được hình thành khi đất nước.zh: 1A高速公路是在我国分为国内和国外两个地区时形成的. 1A高速公路在历史上帮助发展了经过的经济. 当社会作出改变时,1A高速公路也随之出现某些改变,以调整货物流通和运输.

Quốc lộ 1B có chiều dài khoảng hơn 140km.en: Highway 1B has a length of over 140 km. This route connects the two provinces of Shanshan and Thailand. Route 1B intersects Highway 1A at the Town of the Co-Lin, High District, Shanhu.
Quốc lộ 1B có chiều dài khoảng hơn 140km.zh: 1B高速公路全长140多公里. 这条路线连接香山省和泰国两省. 1B国道与香溪高新区同莲镇1A国道交汇.

Quốc lộ 1C là tuyến đường bộ dài 17,3 km.en: The 1C Highway is a 17.3-mile-long route that runs from West to East on the district of the Hong Kong Province. The route extends from the Ritual Pass of Wing Liang, the City of Zhuang to the edge of the Three Citys of Diênh.
Quốc lộ 1C là tuyến đường bộ dài 17,3 km.zh: 1C高速公路是一条全长17.3英里的线路,在香港省辖县境内由西向东贯通. 路线从永良里路口, Zhu市到迪安三市的边缘.

Quốc lộ 1K dài gần 30 km, là con đường h.en: Route 1K is nearly 30 km long, which is the circuit road connecting the city of Lake Chi Minh – Pacific – Plain Nai. The route intersects Route 1A and then passes through the town of Det An - Pacific.
Quốc lộ 1K dài gần 30 km, là con đường h.zh: 1K国道全长近30公里,是连接志明湖市的线路道路 – 太平洋 – 平原奈. 路线与1A路交叉,然后经过德安镇-太平洋.
